candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student – Business Analytics & Intelligent Automation
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Business Analytics & Intelligent Automation. Moving from static dashboards to systems that flag problems and trigger action is exactly the step I want to take after several years of building dashboards for business teams.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data & analytics at TallyMarks Consulting, mostly on real operational data from supply chain, procurement, finance and production.

achievements.impact: I replaced a quality check where users opened an SAP report for each of thousands of materials and compiled results in Excel with a single SAP Analytics Cloud dashboard
I built a Power BI dashboard for the CEO comparing monthly sales against the fiscal-year plan, used to track performance and adjust strategy
I joined a team migrating 42 dashboards from SAP BW to SAP Datasphere and independently rebuilt a full dashboard and its data pipelines on the new platform

letter.problems_section: I use Claude and ChatGPT daily, and my AI degree gives me a solid understanding of how these models work and where they fail. I have not yet built automated notification workflows or advanced Power BI measures, but my track record of picking up new data tools quickly is real, and I would rather test a working prototype than write a long proposal.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for 20 hours per week, for well over six months, and am happy to relocate to Heidelberg to work on site. I would be glad to show you how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
